about.title: About Intersoft
about.body_1: Intersoft is an electronics retailer focused on PCs, components and peripherals. From complete gaming builds to a single stick of RAM, we help you get the right part at the right price.
about.body_2: We ship across Kosovo, Albania and the region, with cash on delivery, POS on delivery and online card payments.
